```{r load data and packages}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

library(ggradar)
library(broom)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(ggseg)
library(afex)
library(emmeans)

source("R/plotting.R")
source("R/rainclouds.R")
source("R/utils.R")
setwd("../data_tidy/")

dt_long <- readRDS("gradients.RDS")
dt_long$group <- factor(dt_long$group, levels = c("SC", "CB"))
dt

df_wide <- dcast(dt_long,
                 subject + group + region + age + sex + hemi + yeo ~ gradient,
                 value.var = "gradient_score")

dt_yeo <- dt_long %>%
  tidyr::expand(nesting(region, yeo, hemi))
```

```{r yeo networks}
cmap_yeo <- c(visual = "#781286", sensorimotor = "#4682B4", 'dorsal attention' = "#00760E", 'ventral attention' = "#C43AFA",
             limbic = "#DCF8A4", frontoparietal = "#E69422", 'default mode'= "#CD3E4E")

dt_yeo$yeo <- plyr::revalue(dt_yeo$yeo, c("VN" = "visual", 
                                          "SMN" = "sensorimotor", 
                                          "DAN" = "dorsal attention",
                                          "VAN" = "ventral attention",
                                          "LN" = "limbic",
                                          "FPN" = "frontoparietal",
                                          "DMN" = "default mode"))

yeo_plot <- ggplot(data = dt_yeo) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser,
             position = position_brain(side + hemi ~.),
             aes(fill = yeo),
             size = 0.05) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cmap_yeo) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cmap_yeo) +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.25, 'cm'))
yeo_plot
```

```{r}
dt_region <- dt_long[, .(centroid = mean(gradient_score)), 
                     by = .(yeo, subject, group, gradient, region, age, sex)]

gradient_labels <- c(gradient_1 = "Gradient 1",
                     gradient_2 = "Gradient 2",
                     gradient_3 = "Gradient 3")
```

```{r figure 1B}
cmap_yeo <- c(VN = "#781286", SMN = "#4682B4", DAN = "#00760E", VAN = "#C43AFA",
             LN = "#DCF8A4", FPN = "#E69422", DMN= "#CD3E4E")

sum_group <- dt_long[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), by = .(group, yeo, region, gradient)] 
sum_group_w <- dcast(sum_group, group + region + yeo ~ gradient, value.var = "mean_grad")

grad_plot12 <- create_grad_plot(sum_group_w, gradient_1, gradient_2, "Gradient 1", "Gradient 2") +
  labs(title = "gradient scores for G1 and G2")  +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
grad_plot12
```

```{r figure 1C}
grad_plot13 <- create_grad_plot(sum_group_w, gradient_1, gradient_3, "Gradient 1", "Gradient 3") +
  labs(title = "gradient scores for G1 and G3")  +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
grad_plot13
```

# gradient 1

```{r paged.print = FALSE}
sum_group <- dt_long[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), by = .(group, yeo, region, gradient)]
sum_group_w <- dcast(sum_group, group + region + yeo ~ gradient, value.var = "mean_grad")

stats_error <- dt_long %>%
  group_by(region, hemi, yeo, gradient, stream) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(gradient_score ~ group, data = ., alternative = "two.sided"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(estimate, parameter, statistic, p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gradient) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region)) %>%
  arrange(yeo)

diff_regions <- sum_group %>%
  left_join(stats_error, by = c("region", "yeo", "gradient")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(estimate))

stats_g1 <- stats_error %>%
  dplyr::filter(gradient == "gradient_1") %>%
  arrange(yeo, stream) %>%
  print(n = 100)

setwd("../results")
write.csv(stats_g1, "stats_g1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
diff_regions_g1 <- right_join(sum_group_w, stats_g1, by = c("region", "yeo"))
```

```{r}
gradient1_df <- sum_group %>%
  filter(gradient == "gradient_1") %>%
  group_by(group)

g1_plot3 <-
  ggplot(gradient1_df) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser,
             position = position_brain(. ~ hemi + side),
             aes(fill = mean_grad)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("blue", "grey", "red"),
                       name = "gradient\nscore") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Calibri Light")) +
  facet_grid(group ~., switch = "y")
# g1_plot3
```

## ROI analysis G1

```{r}
group_diff_g1_plot3 <- create_diff_plot3(diff_regions[gradient == "gradient_1", ])
group_diff_g1_plot3
```

## community-based profiles G1

```{r}
gradient_1 <- dt_region[gradient == "gradient_1", ]

grad1_plot <- create_dist_plot(gradient_1, "community-based profiles")
grad1_plot
```

## group differences in community-based profiles of G1

```{r paged.print = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sum_community <- dt_long[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), 
                         by = .(subject, group, yeo, gradient)]

stats_error_community <- sum_community %>%
  group_by(yeo, gradient) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(mean_grad ~ group, data = .))) %>%
  dplyr::select(estimate, parameter, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gradient) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3) %>%
  arrange(yeo)

setDT(stats_error_community)

grad1_lolli <- stats_error_community[gradient == "gradient_1", ]
grad1_lolli

grad1_lolli_plot <- create_lolli_plot(grad1_lolli, statistic, yeo, "z-score analysis", cmap_yeo)
grad1_lolli_plot
```

## between-network distances

```{r}
# Calculate the mean gradient for yeo == "VN" for each subject and group
vn_means <- gradient_1 %>%
  filter(yeo == "VN") %>%
  group_by(subject, group) %>%
  summarise(vn_mean_grad = mean(centroid, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Join the means with the original dataframe
vn_distance <- gradient_1 %>%
  group_by(subject, group, yeo, age, sex) %>%
  summarise(mean_grad = mean(centroid, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  left_join(vn_means, by = c("subject", "group")) %>%
  mutate(diff_vn = abs(mean_grad - vn_mean_grad)) %>%
  filter(yeo != "VN") %>%
  ungroup()

model1 <- mixed(diff_vn ~ yeo * group + age + sex + (1|subject),
                vn_distance)
model1
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
emm_int <- emmeans(model1, ~ group | yeo)

emm_int_df <- summary(emm_int) %>%
  data.table() %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
emm_int_df

setwd("../results")
write.csv(emm_int_df, "table_s6.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
post_emm_int <- update(pairs(emm_int), adjust = "holm")
post_df <- data.table(summary(post_emm_int))
post_emm_int <- summary(post_emm_int) %>%
  data.table()  %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
post_emm_int

setwd("../results")
write.csv(post_emm_int, "table_s7.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
vn_row <- data.frame(
  contrast = "CB - SC",
```

# Figure 1

```{r}
cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(grad_plot12 +
                                theme(legend.title = element_blank()))

first_row <-
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    yeo_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    legend,
    grad_plot12 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    NULL,
    grad_plot13 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    labels = c("A", "", "B", "", "C"),
    label_size = 8,
    rel_widths = c(0.25, 0.25, 1, 0.05, 1),
    ncol = 5
  )

legend <- cowplot::get_plot_component(group_diff_g1_plot3, "guide-box-bottom", return_all = TRUE)

second_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  group_diff_g1_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"), # + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "inches")
  group_diff_g2_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"), 
  group_diff_g3_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  labels = c("D", "E", "F"),
  label_size = 8,
  hjust = 0,
  ncol = 3
  )

third_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  NULL, 
  legend,
  NULL,
  ncol = 3,
  rel_widths = c(1,1,1)
)

all_figs <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  first_row,
  second_row,
  third_row,
  rel_heights = c(1,1,0.1),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v"
)

setwd("../figures")

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  all_figs,
  filename = "figure_1.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 10,
  width = 16.5,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_1.tiff",
  height = 10,
  width = 16.5,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
all_figs
dev.off()
```

# Figure S2

```{r}
roi_df <- dt_long %>% 
  select(region, yeo, stream) %>%
  mutate(is_roi = ifelse(is.na(stream), "no", "yes")) %>%
  mutate(roi = ifelse(!is.na(stream), region, NA)) %>%
  distinct()

roi_plot <- ggplot(data = roi_df) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser,
             position = position_brain(side ~ hemi),
             aes(fill = is_roi),
             size = 0.1) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.25, 'cm')) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
roi_plot
```
